//: Strictness baseline shared by every TypeScript package in the workspace (extensions/vscode, packages/*, apps/*). Environment-specific globals (DOM / node / vscode) are configured in the per-project tsconfigs of each package — that split is what enforces the layering (vscode: see docs/dev/vscode-extension.md §2.3; a portable package: `tsconfig.json` without DOM + a `tsconfig.dom.json` probe).
//allowImportingTsExtensions: ESM-only build helpers live in `tools/*.mts` / `*.config.mts` and are imported *with* their extension (`./tools/fonts.mts`) so Vite's config loader — and its planned native replacement — never has to guess a module kind. Legal because every project sets `noEmit`.
